description: Dual-layer dependency graph for vibe-* projects. No external packages. DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json maps file-level relationships with confidence tagging: EXTRACTED (verified from source, confidence 1.0), INFERRED (derived from specs/patterns, 0.6–0.95), AMBIGUOUS (flagged for review). Rationale nodes capture WHY, HACK, DECISION comments from source files — surfaced during bug diagnosis and review to prevent intent drift. God nodes identify highest-coupling files — read first in review, flagged in bug diagnosis, blocked from simultaneous parallel writes. CONCEPT_GRAPH.json maps semantic relationships (features, agents, models, components). graph.html is an interactive visual. Auto-updated via git diff. Queried by vibe-fix-bug, vibe-test, vibe-review, vibe-parallel. Primary value is semantic navigation: accurate blast-radius, intent-drift detection via rationale nodes, and safe parallel dispatch via god nodes — not raw token savings (current models have large context windows + prompt caching, so the graph is a precision/focus overlay, not a way to avoid loading context). Triggers on "vibe-graph: build", "vibe-graph: update", "vibe-graph: init", "vibe-graph: rebuild", "vibe-graph: query", "vibe-graph: status".
